recognize_zh: 低倍下小腸黏膜（左側可見隱窩）下方被一大片密集、單調的淋巴樣細胞浸潤取代並擴張腸壁，缺乏濾泡結構，提示腸道淋巴瘤；表皮嗜性（epitheliotropism）需在高倍確認。
features: Dense, diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells effacing the bowel wall
Residual intestinal mucosa with crypts at the left edge, partly infiltrated at its base
No follicular or nodular architecture; no geographic necrosis evident
Scattered small blood vessels traversing the infiltrate
Crush/fold artifact in the mucosa; epitheliotropism not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of small intestine shows residual mucosa with crypts at the periphery and a massive, diffuse, transmural-appearing infiltrate of monotonous lymphoid cells that expands and effaces the underlying wall. The infiltrate is sheet-like, without follicles, prominent necrosis, or a conspicuous inflammatory background. Intraepithelial involvement cannot be evaluated at this power and requires higher magnification. In the context of CD3+, CD56+, TIA1+ tumor cells with epitheliotropism, findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: EATL shows pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with abundant necrosis and an inflammatory background, is usually CD56-negative, and arises in celiac disease, unlike the monotonous CD56+ infiltrate of MEITL.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the intestine
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and is CD20+/CD3-, whereas MEITL cells are small-to-medium and CD3+/CD8+/CD56+.
ENKTL shows angiocentricity with extensive necrosis and is EBER-positive, while MEITL is EBV-negative and characteristically epitheliotropic.
MCL is composed of small cleaved B cells that are CD20+, CD5+ and cyclin D1+, rather than CD3+ cytotoxic T cells.
